name: technical-team-marketplace
description: Tests and validation for the technical-team Claude Code plugin in plugins/team/.

scripts.validate: claude plugin validate plugins/team --strict && claude plugin validate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json --strict
scripts.eval: claude plugin eval plugins/team --tag smoke --runs 1 --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --ablation none --scaffold --allow-tools Write Edit --judge-model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 5 --threshold 0.8 --trust-plugin --no-publish --concurrency 6
scripts.eval:full: claude plugin eval plugins/team --runs 3 --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --ablation with-without --scaffold --allow-tools Write Edit --judge-model claude-sonnet-5-5 --max-cost-usd 15 --threshold 0.8 --trust-plugin --no-publish --concurrency 6
